mods.name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ Refabricated (26.3 R1-hotfix3)
mods.description: An unofficial Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, based on upstream 1.1.8-hotfix. R1-hotfix3 for Minecraft 26.3 is the third hotfix build on the R1 baseline of the 26.3 line, ported from the 26.2 R3-hotfix2 source: it migrates the renderer to Mojang's RenderPearl backend (com.mojang.blaze3d.* -> com.mojang.renderpearl.*), follows vanilla's split of ItemInHandRenderer into FirstPersonHandsAndItems plus FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRenderer, updates the scope shaders to ShaderC #include, and restores REI 26.3.823, Zoomify 2.16.3+26.3, and Shoulder Surfing Reloaded 26.3-5.2.0+fabric compatibility alongside JEI and Carry On 2.12.0. R1 also reworks the Iris 26.3 scope-mask mode detection, adds pipeline prewarming, migrates block loot tables to the 26.3 schema, parses gun-smith recipe ingredients lazily so legacy gun packs no longer break world loading, and opts vanilla recipe serializers into Fabric recipe sync so client JEI/REI works on dedicated servers without JEI/REI. The R1 baseline was verified in-game by the maintainer (vanilla, Iris, dedicated server) in September 2026; the R1-hotfix2 updates (including the 26.2 R3-hotfix3 backports: JEI recipe refresh after gun-pack sync, bullet-hole orientation, and the YSM adapter facade) have passed CI/static checks and await in-game verification. R1-hotfix3 ports the 26.2 workbench, statue and target fixes, updates target minecart skin handling, and keeps resolved target UUID profiles dynamic for client-side skin lookup; these changes await in-game verification. See docs/CHANGELOG_26_3_R1.md for coverage details. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team. The version keeps 1.1.8 as its SemVer core and uses '+fabric.26.3.R1-hotfix3' build metadata so existing gun-pack version requirements continue to work.

mods.name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ Refabricated (26.2 R3-hotfix4)
mods.description: An unofficial Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, based on upstream 1.1.8-hotfix. R3-hotfix4 for Minecraft 26.2 adds a built-in port of VellEagle's TacZ Mesh Loader [TML] for high-poly 'mesh' gun models with first-person GPU static baking (provides 'taczmeshloader'), in-scope clipping of arms/reticle/sight text under shaders, plus scope text, inspect-animation and PIP fixes; it also fixes the Mac/Iris world-transparency path by limiting scope-mask injection to HAND programs and assigning a non-conflicting sampler unit, and removes several recipe, whitelist, sound-resource and Iris pipeline warnings. The R3-hotfix4 release fixes a round of silent block-layer regressions: multi-block workbenches no longer drop two items when the non-root half is broken, statue guns are returned when the statue is removed, and named targets keep their owner and skin across restarts. It also fixes two guaranteed 26.2 crashes: placing a renamed target threw a NullPointerException and left the item unconsumed, and a renamed target minecart crashed the client render thread every frame. Target owners now use vanilla ResolvableProfile with client-side PlayerSkinRenderCache skin resolution (the same path as vanilla heads), falling back to the default skin. The R3-hotfix2 release neutralizes the zRot=±0.1 rad that vanilla 1.21.9+ writes into first-person arms, restoring the authored hand-to-gun alignment for every first-person gun view. R2 previously added the stable replaceable-ammunition and named gameplay-hook surfaces, Carry On 2.11 workbench compatibility, built-in JEI/REI Ammo Query, and post-sync recipe-viewer refreshes. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team. The version keeps 1.1.8 as its SemVer core and uses '+fabric.26.2.R3-hotfix4' build metadata so existing gun-pack version requirements continue to work.

mods.name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ Refabricated (1.21.11 R3-hotfix4)
mods.description: An unofficial Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, based on upstream 1.1.8-hotfix. R3-hotfix4 for Minecraft 1.21.11 keeps the R2 ammunition/gameplay hooks, Carry On workbench compatibility, built-in JEI/REI ammo queries and the R2-hotfix Gizmos-based headshot debug boxes, and adds the LR 0.4.3 tactical sync backported from the 26.2 branch: cooked-fuse detonation timing, melee-only idle animation input, ambient-lit smoke clouds, display_offset/entity_transform content-pack transforms, a content-pack-driven consumable renderer, and the restored LRTactical item model JSONs. From R3 the built-in mesh loader does its GPU static baking in every context (first person, in-world, and under shader packs), so a server full of high-poly mesh guns stops transforming vertices on the CPU. The R3-hotfix2 release restored the put-away animation that was missing on 1.21.11, added the missed chest-boat/chest-raft entries to the interact whitelist, pulled in the corrected Glock 17 draw-animation sounds, dropped the pinned Iris HAND pipeline classification for vanilla entity/item rendering, and gave the mesh loader's GPU baking path per-bone Iris render passes. The R3-hotfix3 source also includes selected 26.3-line changes adapted to the 1.21.11 baseline (JEI refresh hardening, bullet-hole orientation, legacy gun-smith ingredients, and multi-block workbench drops); in-game verification is still pending. The R3-hotfix4 source adds selected 26.2-line block fixes adapted to the 1.21.11 baseline (creative-mode workbench drop suppression, the statue gun dropping when the statue is removed, target-owner persistence, and head profiles for renamed targets and target minecarts); in-game verification is still pending. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team. The version keeps 1.1.8 as its SemVer core and uses '+fabric.1.21.11.R3-hotfix4' build metadata so existing pack version requirements continue to work.
